texts.academy_hint: A short course opens beside the screen it teaches.
texts.auto_delivery_auto_request: Book a delivery for paid orders
texts.auto_low_stock_reorder: Draft a reorder when stock is low
texts.auto_receipt_delivery: Send receipts the way the customer chose
texts.auto_reorder_one_tap: One-tap reorder from the last supplier
texts.auto_setup_autofill: Set up my business for me
texts.auto_sync_retry: Send waiting items when the link is back
texts.automations_intro: Every automation is listed here with what it does, its level and an off switch. Nothing moves money, changes a password or acts beyond its level.
texts.data_sharing_body: A supplier sees how its own products sell in your shop only if you choose to share. One consent per supplier, withdrawable any time. Your data is never sold.
texts.day_close_body: {sales} sales, {total}. Cash expected in the drawer {cash}. Confirmed {confirmed}, waiting {waiting}.
texts.details_secure: Details are shown by the licensed issuer after a fresh check, for a short time, never offline.
texts.difference_flagged: Difference noted for the owner. Nothing is blocked.
texts.event_log: Event log (what the device sends and the cloud answers)
texts.failed_try_again: The partner declined. Nothing was taken. Try another method.
texts.float_forecast: About {days} days of float left at the usual pace (estimate)
texts.float_read_live: Read live from the partner. LynkOmni never holds your float.
texts.freeze_requested: Freeze requested. Shown as frozen only when the issuer confirms.
texts.group_failed: Group not reached. Nobody is charged.
texts.group_reached: Group reached. Each shop pays the supplier for its own part.
texts.identity_check: The partner checks the customer's identity
texts.internet_help: Untick to work offline: facts are saved as Queued and sent later. Agent, collection and partner services never start offline.
texts.joined: Joined. You pay the supplier for your own part only if the group is reached.
texts.laptop_note: This is the owner's view in a browser. Selling and cash run only on a registered device.
texts.limit_exceeded: Over the limit. Nothing was sent.
texts.locale_card: Country, language, currency and time zone come from your country pack. Change any of them with one tap.
texts.locked_idle: Locked after two minutes without a touch
texts.low_float: Low float: top up through the partner
texts.mesh_no_money: LynkMesh carries data, never money, and takes no fee. B cannot read or change what it carries.
texts.mesh_relay: Sent through a nearby device, awaiting cloud
texts.needs_registered_device: Selling, cash, shifts and agent services run only on a device registered to the business.
texts.never_before_confirmed: Never hand over cash before the partner confirms.
texts.new_order_test: Send a test order from the till
texts.no_events: No events yet. Try the screen.
texts.not_proof: A text message or a screenshot is not proof of payment. Only Confirmed counts.
texts.nothing_understood: Nothing matched. Try again or tap the products.
texts.online_only: Agent, collection and partner services need a connection. Nothing is queued.
texts.order_qr: Order and pay at the table by QR
texts.placeholder_limits: Limits and prices are placeholders until the issuer is signed.
texts.practice_mode_help: A training copy, clearly marked. Nothing it records is real and nothing syncs.
texts.printed_tickets: Kitchen tickets are printed on this plan
texts.proof_photo: Proof: photo of the parcel (never a person)
texts.provider_declines_help: The sandbox partner answers Failed instead of Confirmed.
texts.real_user: Show what a merchant sees today in the chosen country
texts.real_user_help: Only what a signed licensed partner covers there works; the rest shows "Coming to your country soon". The sample country has no partners signed yet.
texts.referred: Referred to the partner. The partner decides and tells the customer.
texts.relay_body: This device has no connection. A nearby LynkOmni device carries the sealed batch to the cloud. Nothing is shown as accepted until the cloud accepts it.
texts.sandbox_note: Sample data, sandbox partners, test money only. Not reviewed by a designer yet.
texts.second_currency: About {amount} (estimate at today's rate; the sale stays in {currency})
texts.setup_done_in: Set up in under two minutes. First sale within a minute.
texts.start_group_pro: Starting a group needs Pro or Max.
texts.tamper_test: Test: B changes the batch on the way
texts.tips_belong: Tips belong to the business. LynkOmni takes no share.
texts.voice_hint: Say the items, for example "two bags of rice, one soap". You confirm before the sale is saved.
texts.waiting_partner: Waiting for the partner to confirm
texts.why_cash_difference_flag: A cash count differed from what the till expected. Nothing was blocked.
texts.why_chat_routing: The message went to the person who handles this kind of question.
texts.why_chat_suggested_replies: A customer wrote; replies were suggested in their language for a person to pick.
texts.why_chat_summary: You asked for a summary; figures stay visible and the summary is labelled.
texts.why_commission_match: A partner statement arrived and was matched line by line; each difference was flagged.
texts.why_day_close_prepare: Closing time: sales, cash expected in the drawer, items running low and anything unusual, in one message.
texts.why_delivery_auto_request: Your rule booked the cheapest partner for a paid order. You can undo it for five minutes.
texts.why_device_health: A registered device has an old app, a low battery, little storage or was not seen for days.
texts.why_expiry_alert: A batch expires within a week; a discount or write-off was drafted.
texts.why_kitchen_routing: A table order reached the kitchen screen, or the printer on the Free plan.
texts.why_low_float_warning: Your float at a partner fell under a fifth of a usual day.
texts.why_low_stock_reorder: Stock reached its reorder level; a purchase was drafted for you to confirm.
texts.why_negative_stock_flag: A sale took stock below zero while offline. The sale was never blocked; count the product.
texts.why_product_from_photo: You took a photo; LynkAssist drafted the name, price and category. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
texts.why_receipt_delivery: The receipt went out by the channel the customer chose, within your plan.
texts.why_reorder_one_tap: You received this product before; one tap reorders from the same supplier after you confirm.
texts.why_setup_autofill: A business was created; LynkAssist drafted its profile from the country pack for you to confirm.
texts.why_shift_reminder: A shift starts within the hour.
texts.why_staff_pin_lock: No touch for two minutes; the staff PIN lock engaged.
texts.why_sync_retry: The link came back; sales and payments were sent first, pictures last.
